analogy.rationale: TRPV channels are non-selective cation channels with limited expression in these cell lines, so TRPV agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other TRPV/ion-channel modulators and cannabinoid receptor ligands, which share partial target overlap (CNR1) and similarly sparse expression.
